항목.프롬프트: An exhausted man, one of David's Israelite warriors, a young man with a short dark beard, a rounded bronze helmet, a tan wool tunic with a leather armor vest and leather sandals, sitting on the ground with his knees up resting after a long march, his spear lying on the ground beside him, one hand on his knee and the other hand wiping his brow, tired but kind face, three-quarter view facing left, whole body visible. Exactly two arms and exactly two hands, each hand with four fingers and a thumb.

A joyful man, one of David's Israelite warriors, a young man with a short dark beard, a rounded bronze helmet, a tan wool tunic with a leather armor vest and leather sandals, standing and raising both arms high in welcome with open hands, his spear left aside, big happy smile, three-quarter view facing left, whole body visible. Exactly two arms and exactly two hands, each hand with four fingers and a thumb.

A big heap of recovered household goods and spoils piled on the sand: cloth sacks of grain tied with cord, round clay jars and water pots, a small open wooden chest with gold and silver cups and coins, rolled colorful woven rugs, folded cloaks, a bundle of white sheep wool and a leather bag. No people, no animals, no statues, no idols, no religious symbols.

One small plump cloth sack of plundered goods made of rough tan burlap, tied at the top with a brown cord, bulging with round shapes, a gold coin and the rim of a silver cup peeking out of the opening. No people, no text.
